title: a16z Podcast: On Wearables, Quantified Self, and Biohacking

reader_summary.source_label: From the episode notes — transcript not yet available
reader_summary.headline: It’s the end of the beginning — not the beginning of the end — for wearables.
reader_summary.overview: It’s the end of the beginning — not the beginning of the end — for wearables, argue the guests in this episode of the a16z Podcast. Especially as we move from the first, to the next, generation of wearable devices: not just activity trackers and watches but VR/AR gear, “hearables”.

key_points.text: Especially as we move from the first, to the next, generation of wearable devices: not just activity trackers and watches but VR/AR gear.

The quantified self movement then takes these empirical tracking- and data-gathering tools to better reason about what works and doesn’t work in our bodies to help us solve problems and live better lives..
Yet the act of gathering data isn’t the hard part… it’s linking them to insights and outcomes.
